The user wants to set the log level of `svc-beacon-348` to `debug` and check the size of `bucket-logs-8325`, then submit a report.
Following the runbook:
1. Read ticket file (Done).
2. GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-348` (To check current status).
3. POST `/api/tickets/TCK-462434/token` (To get a token).
4. POST `/api/services/svc-beacon-348/log-level` with `level: debug` and the token.
5. Call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-logs-8325`.
6. `submit_report`.

Current step: 2. GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-348`.
